name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 66 – Am 34
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 66a. Recalls that the ECtHR has explicitly confirmed that the right to freedom of expression protects speech that may offend, shock or disturb; warns against the increasing political and institutional tendency to weaponise subjective concepts such as ‘hate speech’ to silence dissenting, unpopular or provocative political discourse;
